caseNameFull: Goldberg, Commissioner of Social Services of the City of New York v. Kelly
attorneys: J. Lee Rankin, Stanley Buchsbaum, and John J. Loflin for appellant., Martin Garbus for appellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y. Probable jurisdiction noted and case set for oral argument immediately following No. 634, ante, p. 970. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief expressing the views of the United States.
